# One commit e-mail per line, exactly as Weblate writes it into the commit
# author (see `gh pr view <N> --json commits`). Everything after # is a note.
# A Weblate PR auto-merges only when EVERY commit in it is by someone on this
# list — anyone else's first batch waits for a maintainer to read it once and
# then add them here. See .github/workflows/weblate-automerge.yml.
